`vue-advanced-chat-2.1.2.umd.js` is [vue-advanced-chat](https://github.com/advanced-chat/vue-advanced-chat) 2.1.2, with Vue bundled in,
copied from npm so the room's page loads no outside scripts for the chat itself.
